_comment: Release gate for the shipping Jess macro parsers. Both repositories are pinned so a green run always names the same parser source and fixture source.
_referenceNote: The 0.58.0 selective-assembly commit, at the plugin default budget the pinned jess build uses. 0.50.2 embedded the whole-grammar assembly that docs/design/runtime-and-size-contract.md rule 4 removes. This commit is retained on main because parseman merges pull requests with merge commits; it is never the candidate HEAD, which carries the release commits after it.
